description: This file defines a PHP trait named EncryptionHelperTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides utility methods for encryption-related functionality, including retrieving a Cryptographer instance and checking if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: getCryptographer
methods.description: Returns an instance of Cryptographer if encryption is enabled and the key exists; initializes it if not already created.

methods.name: encryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether encryption is enabled by verifying if a Cryptographer instance is available.
